Junior Backend Developer (Python / Go)

Pune, Maharashtra, India (On-site)

About Persistent:
Persistent is a trusted global digital engineering and enterprise modernization partner.

Job Details:
• Develop backend microservices and REST APIs using Python, Go, and PostgreSQL.
• Implement automated tests, Git workflows, and CI/CD pipelines.
• Collaborate with architects to optimize database query performance and caching.

Requirements:
• 0-2 years of backend software development experience.
• Strong foundations in data structures, algorithms, SQL, and Git.
• B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science or related degree.
• Pune office location.
